expect.label: the waiting line begins after EXACTLY two leading spaces — the chrome column — and the reason itself starts in that column, with no status-label prefix between the indent and the reason (BOS-863). Whitespace-preserving on purpose: `normalized` collapses the indent away AND would tolerate a restored prefix, which is why the sibling BOS-668 scenario cannot prove either half. Before BOS-718 there was one space here
